consequences: C03 pressure drag and any drag-derived quantity are not currently defensible.
The conformal interface defect at Zone23.j1 <-> Zone7.j0 is a symptom of this, not a separate problem.
The wall-normal recovery did not cause it and does not fix it.
A grid-independence study on C01/C02/C03 will inherit the same collar topology unless it is changed first.

findings.finding: 137 of Zone7's 296 faces carry cp > 1 in both attempts, with a maximum of 5.328 before the wall-normal correction and 4.160 after. The count is identical across the two meshes, so this is a property of the collar block rather than of the wall spacing.

findings.caveat: Clipping is a bound on the contaminated fraction, not a correction. The true value is unknown until the collar resolves the stagnation region properly.
findings.finding: Zone7 occupies 2.25 percent of the wall area but contributes 0.02459 of the 0.03079 total pressure drag, about 80 percent, because a leading-edge collar faces the flow. Clipping its cp to the physical maximum removes 0.01071 of pressure drag, 34.8 percent of c_Dp. Lift is barely affected at 1.02 percent.

The rind planes stored around Zone7 are well behaved, maximum cp 0.676 and 0.420, while the physical interior rows carry the impossible values. The anomaly is therefore in Zone7's own solution and is not a CGNS rind or index-mapping artifact of the reader.

An independent surface quadrature over all wall zones reproduces ADflow's own reported forces to five significant figures for pressure drag and to 0.05 percent for lift, so the reader, cell areas and normals used for these conclusions are validated against the solver itself.

mechanism.conclusion: Four cells absorb a median 103 degrees of surface turning around the leading edge, 34.3 degrees per cell, at roughly one cell per nose radius. The surface normal rotates so far within a single cell that the pressure reconstruction there is meaningless, which is how cp exceeds its physical maximum. This is a resolution deficit in the chordwise wrap direction, not a wall-spacing, smoothing or solver problem.

controlled_contrast.interpretation: The trailing-edge collar uses the identical end_points value and the identical block width, and is completely clean. It turns through zero degrees because the trailing edge is a blunt flat base. Block width is therefore not the discriminator; surface turning per cell is.

mechanism.refinement_family_consequence: end_points is 3, 4 and 5 at C01, C02 and C03, so the wrap carries 2, 3 and 4 cells and absorbs roughly 50, 40 and 34 degrees of turning per cell. The leading edge is severely under-resolved at every level of the planned family, and the sequence is nowhere near the asymptotic range. A Richardson or GCI estimate built on this family would be arithmetically well formed and physically meaningless for any pressure-derived quantity.

physical_bound.note: cp above this requires total pressure above freestream stagnation.

recommended_next_actions: Raise the leading-edge wrap resolution until turning per cell is small; a conventional wall-resolved target is at most 5 to 10 degrees, implying roughly 12 to 24 wrap cells against the present 4.

Decide explicitly whether end_points may be decoupled from chord_points and collar_points. The master guide couples them, so raising the leading-edge wrap alone needs a prospective policy version with an ADR rather than an in-place edit.
Rebuild C01 and C02 with the same decision before any grid-convergence work, so the family shares one leading-edge law.
Re-run the interface and cp-bound checks on the rebuilt meshes; the cp bound needs CFD, the turning-per-cell measure does not and can screen candidates mesh-only.
Do not use attempt03 or attempt04 pressure drag in any paper claim.
summary: The leading-edge collar strip NSWallAdiabaticBCZone7 carries surface pressure coefficients above the physical maximum of about 1.0018 for this Mach 0.0837 case, over roughly half of its faces, on both the pre-correction and the corrected C03 mesh. The same strip supplies about four fifths of the total pressure drag, so the C03 pressure-drag label is not trustworthy until the collar is fixed.

zone_identification.evidence: At mid-span the five chordwise vertices run x = 0.32478, 0.32282, 0.32157, 0.32289, 0.32541, so the strip straddles the local chordwise minimum, which is the stagnation line. It spans y = 0.0003 to 0.9786, the full half span.
zone_identification.role: leading-edge collar: a four-cell-wide strip wrapping the leading edge
